guard: an empty sessions/ directory is skipped locally so the seat starts fresh, and a list_sessions panic names the assertion and path instead of startup failed (unknown)
why: The jcode binary panics in stored_session_ids when sessions/ exists and is empty. That panic is
out of this repo. The connector used to catch listSessions, reuse the dead client for createSession,
and report startup failed (unknown). Operators then renamed the seat. Each mutation restores one
of those defects: listing an empty directory, reusing the dead client, collapsing the named failure
back to unknown, widening the panic site so an unrelated crate's translate.rs is reported as this
defect, letting the local inspection throw and kill a seat that would otherwise start, or naming a
specific wrong cause for a failure the connector does not recognise.

mutations.name: M1 list an empty sessions directory instead of skipping it
mutations.expectRed: list_sessions is not sent when sessions is an empty directory
mutations.cell: list_sessions is not sent when sessions is an empty directory

mutations.name: M2 treat a missing sessions path as the empty-directory defect
mutations.expectRed: a missing sessions path is absent, not empty
mutations.cell: a missing sessions path is absent, not empty

mutations.name: M3 classify prose that mentions the assertion as the panic
mutations.replace: return /chunk size must be non-zero/.test(stderr) ? "chunk size must be non-zero at crates/jcode-harness-api-server/src/translate.rs:1707:38" : undefined;
mutations.expectRed: prose that mentions the assertion is refused
mutations.cell: prose that mentions the assertion is refused

mutations.name: M4 reuse the dead listing client instead of redialing
mutations.expectRed: listing panic still starts a fresh session on a new harness
mutations.cell: listing panic still starts a fresh session on a new harness

mutations.name: M5 forward arbitrary child text as the operator-facing cause
mutations.replace:
if (/write EPIPE/i.test(text)) return "write EPIPE";
  return text;
mutations.expectRed: unrelated child text is not forwarded
mutations.cell: unrelated child text is not forwarded

mutations.name: M6 match any path ending in translate.rs instead of the owning crate
mutations.expectRed: the same filename in another crate is refused
mutations.cell: the same filename in another crate is refused

mutations.name: M7 stop escaping the dots in the panic site
mutations.expectRed: a site differing by one character is refused
mutations.cell: a site differing by one character is refused

mutations.name: M8 rethrow an unreadable sessions directory instead of naming it
mutations.expectRed: the unreadable sessions directory is named to the operator
mutations.cell: the unreadable sessions directory is named to the operator

mutations.name: M9 report an unrecognised harness failure as a closed connection
mutations.expectRed: unrelated child text is not forwarded
mutations.cell: unrelated child text is not forwarded

mutations.name: M10 stay silent about a sessions directory the connector cannot read
mutations.expectRed: the unreadable sessions directory is named to the operator
mutations.cell: the unreadable sessions directory is named to the operator

mutations.name: M11 let an unreadable home die unknown instead of naming the path
mutations.expectRed: an unreadable sessions directory either starts the seat or names sessions_enumeration_failed
mutations.cell: an unreadable sessions directory either starts the seat or names sessions_enumeration_failed
